title: Huggies Newborn Diapers, Little Snugglers Baby Diapers, Size Preemie (up to 6 lbs), 30 Count
description: With up to 12 hours of leak protection for your baby’s delicate skin, Huggies Little Snugglers Diapers are our perfect choice for your little one. Huggies Little Snugglers newborn diapers offer gentle skin protection and showcase a curved and stretchy fit with all-around comfort for a gentle tummy fit. These baby diapers feature Huggies' GentleAbsorb Liner that absorbs wetness on contact to help keep your baby’s skin clean and healthy. Plus, with a soft, pocketed back waistband, these disposable baby diapers help prevent leaks and blowouts while helping keep mess away from your baby's skin. Extra soft materials provide belly comfort and protection from red marks during Tummy Time. Little Snugglers baby diapers are made with a breathable outer cover and are hypoallergenic, dermatologist tested and safe for sensitive skin. Huggies is the only leading brand entirely fragrance free*, our diapers are also made without parabens, lotions, elemental chlorine and natural rubber latex. Little Snugglers also feature a color-changing wetness indicator that lets you know when your baby’s diaper is ready to be changed. Featuring Disney Winnie the Pooh designs, Little Snugglers Diapers are available in size Preemie (up to 6 lbs), size Newborn (up to 10 lbs), size 1 (8-14 lbs), size 2 (12-18 lbs), size 3 (16-28 lbs), size 4 (22-37 lbs), size 5 (27+ lbs) and size 6 (35+ lbs). For the perfect diapering duo, pair Huggies diapers with Huggies Natural Care Sensitive Baby Wipes! (*among leading national diaper brands, across all offered variants)
top_review: These diapers have been a go-to in our house since day one. The Size 2 fits our little one perfectly and holds up well overnight without any leaks. The material is soft and doesn’t irritate sensitive skin, and we really like the wetness indicator—it makes changes more predictable. Having them in a large pack is convenient and cost-effective. Consistent quality, and they do exactly what we need them to do! Extremely easy to clean and provides excellent sleep quality!

Formulated with premium-quality basestocks that protect engines against varnish deposits and contamination, the low-friction formulation helps optimize fuel economy, while quality anti-wear additives, combined with powerful detergents, fight sludge to help keep the engine clean. Valvoline Daily Protection meets the performance requirements of virtually all naturally aspirated and turbocharged and gasoline-fueled passenger cars and light duty trucks, like Dodge Ram, Toyota Tacoma, Toyota Camry, Honda Accord, Jeep Wrangler, Ford F150, Chevy Silverado and many more. Daily Protection provides high-temperature protection to resist breakdown in severe engine environments; low-temperature protection ensures the motor oil flows easily during cold winter weather, reducing wear at start-up. title: Sharpie Accent Retractable Highlighters, Chisel Tip, Fluorescent Yellow, Box of 12
description: Draw attention to important information in notes, text, and documents with Sharpie Retractable Highlighters. Bright fluorescent colors make it easy to read highlighted text and emphasize important passages. Quick-drying ink helps prevent smudging when highlighting over pen and marker inks. And the retractable design prevents your highlighters from drying up and makes for easier storage
categories: ["Office Products","Office & School Supplies","Writing & Correction Supplies","Markers & Highlighters","Highlighters"]
top_review: These are my favorite highlighters. Can be used as either a chiseled or broad tip, depending on how you hold the pen. The retractable feature is very handy and convenient for two reasons. 1. Slows down the drying 2. Prevents accidental marking of clothes and surfaces.Sharpie or nothing for me!I use a lot of highlighters (to emphasize information to clients and to indicate where to sign, etc.) I really like the retractable tip - because you don't have to keep track of a cap and it makes it easy to store pen tip down (which results in longer life) because the tip isn't exposed.I hate caps. They fall on the floor, roll away to hidden or unreachable places. These highlighters are a reliable breeze to use. And you'll need a box, so the tips are fully saturated for bright markings.Maybe it's because of the cold temps and the overall shipment/distribution/exposure to cold? Or just an unlucky batch in general? Not sure. Normally I have nothing but good experiences with Sharpie brand products, but the order of highlighters I just received had all of them dried out and not working. I had no choice but to put in for a return and run out to the office store to get some more since I couldn't wait another 1-2 days for a replacement to arrive. This won't stop me from ordering again though. Sometimes thing just happenI have used sharpies most of my life, especially in academics. I now use them to hwlp me keep track in my paper books/work.THey do not "bleed", are discreet, and have a good shelf life. The retractable tip ones are, IMHO the best, but I'm in my 60sThis is the only type of highlighter I like to use. It is so much easier to click the top like on an ink pen. No top to remove and put back on. Sharpie is the best highlighter on the market as far as I am concerned. No fuss to muss and no mess. No fading. I use highlighters a lot with sewing patterns. I have not been able to find this many of one color in a package for a long time. I love it and usually buy a packet every six months or so.After using these retractable highlighters, I’ll never go back to the standard removable cap version. These are much more convenient. They’re thicker than standard highlighters, about twice as thick as a pencil, but I think that allows them to hold more ink. They seem to last a long time.The ink will only smear if it is used on wet writing. Once it swears, it doesn’t take long to correct itself. It is more of a flourescent yellow, and it dries quickly and retains its brightness. This allows for greater contrast between the ink and the text, making it easier to read. I have tried other colors, and yellow is still the only color that isn’t too dark. I would like to use other colors for successive readings of a text, but for now I’ve given up on that, and exclusively use yellow.Because it is retractable, all it takes is a quick click to keep the nib from drying out. The click is rather loud, about twice as loud as a Pilot G2, so they may not the best for use in a library, but they’re fine for use in a coffee shop. With that in mind, while there is still room for improvement, the one-handed action, not having to replace the cap after each use, and the price, makes these the best highlighters on the market.Usual great Sharpie quality, and much handier to use than the usual clumsy things. I love these and wouldn't buy any other type of highlighter.These highlighters are excellent!! Just click, and use. I use them for marking passages in my bible- and although I can see the highlight through the paper on the next page', it's not too bad. Actually, other than using the wax ones, gonna have this anyways in a bible, as the paper is so thin- and, in my experience, I haven't found that the wax ones work all that well. So, to sum up- I highly recommend these! ease of use- brightness of the ink- and they last a long time.Hubo un atraso considerable de aprox mes y medio por falta de existencias. Pero como hay otras alternativas pasó por alto.El producto en sì es bueno, efectivamente es retractil y cada vez que se introduce la punta hay una rejilla que se cierra para evitar que se seque.El ancho de la punta es ideal para tesxtos de tamaño pequeño-mediano sin necesidad de usar sólo la punta como en otros que son màs gruesos.Es ligero y el clip acomoda bien sobre una camisa aunque ciertamente sobresale mucho de ella.Las 5 estrellas son por el diseño retractil y la rejilla para evitar que se seque. Ademàs, es dificil encontrarlos en el mercado.I use it to highlight when I study. I hated the fact that every time I wanted to underline something I had to take the cap off and put it back on a couple seconds later. It may not seem like a big deal, but when you are diligently studying its a pain to have to manage the cap and not lose it. This has saved me sooo much time. I love these highlighters and will continue to buy and recommend them to anyone looking to save some time and increase their productivity.These highlighters are awesome. I do extreme cross stitch, and I mark my pattern off as I go with these Sharpies. I used to use the cheap ones, but the caps are so annoying. I was concerned when I first tried them that they'd dry out quickly, but so far they've lasted at least as long as regular ones.

top_review: I'm firmly in the camp that says Yellow Jacket are the best cords on the market.  My contractor friends turned me on to them years ago and I haven't bought anything else since.  Following a recent power outtage I picked up a few extra 12/3 - 50' for a "rainy day".  12/3 should be enough for a refrigerator, sump pump, a furnace, or a window A/C (up to 10kbtu or so).  Obvoiusly, do not use these on more than one appliance at time and not anything that exceeds 15A.  Make sure your power source can safely handle these loads as well.  They're not double or triple the price of the competition so why not get the best?

title: Strathmore Printmaking Paper Pad 11"X14"-15 Sheets -62433110, BROWN
description: The Strathmore 400 Series Heavyweight Printmaking Pad contains a natural white paper made for printmaking. Ideal for relief printing with block or linocut, screen printing, lithography, intaglio, practicing, and proofing; this paper utilizes medium-textured surface that is both soft and durable to absorb large amounts of ink. The Strathmore 400 Series Heavyweight Printmaking Pad contains high levels of alpha cellulose wood fiber to improve absorption while making your images pop. Paper is our art form, and we celebrate artists. We have kept the tradition of creating beautiful, high-performing papers alive for over 125 years. Choice of paper is one of the most important decisions an artist makes in determining the outcome of their work. No matter your choice of medium, you can be confident Strathmore paper will enhance your artistic efforts.
top_review: This paper is great. I know it’s technically for print making and it works great for that, but it is also some of my favorite watercolor paper.

title: Winsor & Newton Professional Acrylic Paint, 200ml (6.75-oz) Tube, Lemon Yellow
description: Winsor & Newton Professional Acrylic (previously known as Artists' Acrylics) is our finest quality acrylic range and represents a breakthrough in acrylic color technology. After extensive research and development, we are proud to present the brightest ever range of Professional Acrylic. By combining our color making experience with the latest developments in resin technology we have taken 'brilliance' to a new level. And that's not all. Not only are our colors brilliant when wet but they remain as bright when dry - so what you see is what you get. Working with artists around the world confirmed that above all else, acrylic artists want the brightest, most vivid colors that do not change as they dry. Our range of Professional Acrylic represents a significant breakthrough in achieving this and much more. Lemon Yellow is a clear bright yellow color. It is part of the Hansa pigments which were discovered in the early 1900s in Germany by the Hoechst company.

description: Cats can access spaces with more confidence with Armarkat’s model B3001 Classic cat steps. There are three convenient steps for your feline, with each platform 9" deep. top_review: The stairs work perfectly for our older cat to use to get into our high bed. She will sometimes sleep on the stairs since they're carpeted. Unfortunately, our one cat uses it as a scratching post so the carpet has been ripped off on the legs. We're still happy with the stairs---they're sturdy for our 15lb cat. Just know that cats may use it as a post so the carpet won't hold up as long.This item has been approved by HER MAJESTY (sometimes answers to the name of Fuzz), the 15 lbs. 16 year old feline that lets me reside in her territory. The set up is extremely easy especially with Her Majesty inspecting and helping with the process. Immediately after the set up and placed next to her human's sleeping place (bed), Her Majesty faced marked each step and proceeded to claim her share of the bed. There was no problem going down the steps to have a nibble of food and then returning back up the steps to have a nice nap. Definitely kitty approved.Special note from Her Majesty's personal assistant - this has saved my coverlet and sheets. No longer does my calico have to climb up the covers to get to me at night since she has gotten too old and heavy to jump upon the bed now. Also, it is much easier on her joints than jumping down off the bed. It's very solid and extremely easy to put together but the instructions are useless. Here's the best way to put the thing together especially if you are doing it by yourself (with the help of your kitty, of course):1 - Sitting on the floor, take everything out of the box and arrange close around you. Put the box on it's side in front of you. You will use it as support for the posts until one side is done. (Not needed if you have another Human to help you but Her Majesty did help by laying inside the box so that it did not move.)2 - Hold the base on it's side with the top (fleece side) facing away from you. You should be looking at the bare wood bottom. Take one of the tallest post and lay it on the box with the hole matching up with the top hole at one end of the fleece side of the base. The box will help support the post. Take a bolt and run it up from the bottom into the post and tighten with the allen wrench. DO NOT OVER TIGHTEN! It should be tight enough to hold the post. You will come back AFTER putting the steps on and tighten it down completely. By putting everything together first and then going back and really tightening the bolts, it makes it a lot easier to get all the steps and posts straight. Trust me.3 - Take the other tallest post and attach it to the corresponding bottom hole. Remember to tighten enough to hold the post steady but still leave a little bit of wiggle room.4 - Take the next tallest posts and attached them using the bolts in the next set of holes. After this you can ditch the box because these posts will support the base on its side.5 - Finish attaching all the posts and stand the base right side up.6 - The steps are 7" wide with the bolts 4" from one side leaving 3" on the other side. THE BACK AND FRONT ARE NOT MARKED - the back is the 4" width. The front is the smaller 3" width. The steps should fit against the posts as shown in the picture with the smaller overhang. Start with the smaller posts, put one of the steps on top, matching the holes and tighten down completely. MAKE SURE THAT THE BACK OF THE STEP IS AGAINST THE NEXT HIGHER POST. It really does matter - a longer overhang makes it harder for the kitty to step down. Really tighten the steps down - this will align and keep the posts straight.7 - Continue putting the steps on, really tightening the bolts. Pay close attention to the top step as you don't have a post to back up to. Check the overhang to be sure that you don't have the step on backwards.8 - Turn the steps onto their side and really tighten the bottom bolts. There should be no movement in the steps or posts.9 - Pet the pretty kitty and place the steps where your feline has indicated that she wants them.I was attracted to this because we recently moved from a two-story to a single level home and my cat absolutely loved playing on the carpeted stairs. Something about rolling down the steps one by one just gave her purpose in life. It was a real pain trying to go up or down while she was in one of those moods. I wanted to bring back some of the joy that she had lost in the move so I specifically sought out towers with a stair-like structure.Firstly, very, very easy to assemble. I got home from work and just bolted all the pieces together and it took maybe 10-15 mins. Extremely straight forward to the point that I didn’t even need to read the instructions. You just look at it and it’s pretty obvious what to do, no specific order. Very sturdy as well. I as a 115 lb person sat atop the top step and wiggled and it barely wobbled at the base. My cat is a very aggressive player. Once she warmed up to it, she’s been launching herself at it, jumped on the back part sideways and swung herself on top like a spider monkey, and has been slinking between the gaps under the steps for surprise attacks. And of course, rolling down step by step. Not once have I seen it wobble. She’s only 7 lbs, so she’s a tiny little thing, but I don’t think it would wobble with a big cat, or even multiple cats. The thing is very sturdy and the steps are snuggly right next to each other for optimum support.The one downside are the pretty big bolts that stick out to secure the steps to the pillars. I’ve included a picture so you can gauge for yourself but they they do stick out quite a bit. My cat is the type to bite whatever’s nearest when she’s playful, even table tops sometimes. She did bite the bolts a few times when we first got it and that was very concerning to me. Metal is definitely not good for biting as aggressively as she does when she plays. But I haven’t seen her bite them in a while. There’s also a weird metal plate screwed into the bottom step, or at least the step that I put at the bottom as there isn’t a specific order. Absolutely, completely unnecessary, just the brand name. Could have been a little rubber thing, or some other softer material, or better yet, somewhere on the base instead of in the middle of a step. She’s bitten that a couple times too. And that one protrudes in a way that could potentially cut a paw pad, whereas I don’t think the bolts are sharp enough to do that. Just seems like a poor design choice to put so many exposed, protruding metal pieces on a cat tower. I can’t say I’ve ever seen anything like it and if I had known about that part I might have looked for a different one, but I’ll leave that to an individual judgement.My cat loves it, but every cat is different. If this kind of structure is complimentary to your cats typical ply style, I’m sure they will love it too.This is my second set of stairs. I bought them so my arthritic cats could easily get on the bed. Surprisingly my 5yr old cats use them and my 7 week old kittens. I only buy Armakat products for my cats. We have 4 Armakat cat trees.I bought this for my kitty who injured one of her back legs. The height and spacing of the steps were perfect for her to comfortably get where she wanted to go without hurting herself. There are only two small issues: the top step is a tiny bit wobbly, and the space between the posts is too tempting for her try to awkwardly go through. I stabilized the top step by tying its posts to the posts of the middle step with zip ties. To keep her from going between the posts, I cut some cardboard rectangles to put between the steps. After those minor mods, it worked so well that I bought a second one.At first my cat would not go up the steps. I was so frustrated because she has no problem going up and down our steps to the second floor. Then one day my husband turned the steps sideways where one side is against the bed and from then on my cat hasn't had any problems going up and down them. I'm so happy I bought this step ramp.Good product for my arthritic cat but removed the name plate as thought he could catch his claws in it. Also watching bolts are tight as they could cause same issue. Colour not very practical but overall good product.Brilliant very sturdyMy cat is very nervous and skittish but after coaxing her up and down the steps with treats for a few days she quickly started using the stairs on her own (to get up my very tall bed and to the window's cat flap). The stairs were easy to assemble, the steps are sturdy and don't move when my cat walks on them.The only thing I would change is the carpeting material on the posts. My cat has taken to scratch at them (as they make for a great scratching post) but the carpeting fuzz comes off the posts easily and gets stuck in between her toes. I plan to cover the posts with sisal rope.Es ist bereits die zweite Katzentreppe, die ich gekauft habe und man kann nur über die positiven Eigenschaften schreiben, denn negative gibt es keine:- Weicher und sehr schöner Plüschbezug, der edel wirkt- einfache Montage, die man ohne Hilfe bewätigt- im Gegensatz zu anderen Treppen hat diese - mit 64 cm - gerade die richtige Höhe, um Katzen den Aufstieg auf Kratzbaum etc. zu erleichtern- sehr stabiles Modell, das auch für große und schwere Katzen geeignet istUnd sollte die Katze die Treppe anfangs ablehnen (wie es bei mir der Fall war), dann einfach mit einem Baldrian-Spray besprühen und schon "fliegt" die Katze darauf.Alles in allem eine absolute Kaufempfehlung und ein Top-Produkt!

description: Developed with the help of leading exotic veterinarians and nutritionists, Oxbow Critical Care Herbivore is the industry standard in recovery nutrition for small herbivores like rabbits and guinea pigs experiencing poor nutritional status due to illness, surgery, or other health challenges. Whether you're stocking an emergency kit or enhancing your everyday pet care routine, this veterinary formula is a must-have for any responsible small pet parent. This powdered formula is easy to prepare—just add water—and provides a complete, balanced blend of essential nutrients, including guinea pig vitamin C, crucial for optimal health and recovery. High in fiber from timothy hay, Critical Care supports healthy gut physiology and digestion, helping restore appetite and encourage natural eating behaviors. There’s no added sugar, making it a healthier choice for sensitive systems. Perfect for use as guinea pig food or bunny food during times of stress, Critical Care is designed with high palatability and a natural anise flavor that encourages intake, even in picky or weak animals. Whether you're managing rabbit food for a post-surgical pet or supplementing your guinea pig’s diet, this formula delivers results. Ideal for use alongside other rabbit supplies, bunny supplies, and guinea pig food essentials, Critical Care fits seamlessly into your existing care plan. Support your pet’s recovery with the trusted solution used by vets and pet parents alike—Critical Care Herbivore, featuring timothy hay for guinea pigs and timothy hay for rabbits, for targeted, high-quality nutrition.

description: Bring on the unusual projects with Cricut EasyPress Mini, a pocket-sized heat press designed for supreme precision. The compact design effortlessly glides over extra-small projects, like shoes, stuffed animals & more. Comfortably curve around contours, slide between buttons, and squeeze into seems with the heat plate's precision tip. Cricut EasyPress Mini fits perfectly in its insulated safety base to protect your workspace, and the auto-off feature turns the press off after 10 minutes of inactivity. The ceramic-coated heat plate offers even, edge-to-edge heat for quality, consistent results. Just cycle between 3 heat settings to adjust the temperature for projects of all types. Works with major brands of iron-on (HTV), Infusible Ink & sublimation products. An excellent complement to Cricut machines.

top_review: I bought these to press simple vinyls on my own clothing.  Heats up quickly, solid quality product, very functional for small projects, comes with it's own stand so we aren't burning the counter or table, i love that it has an auto shut off as i am forgetful sometimes about unplugging and/or turning things off.  Works great for what i need it for.

description: Product Description Estwing's Rip Claw Solid Steel Hammer provide unsurpassed balance and temper. The head and handle are fully polished and forged in one piece. Our exclusive Shock Reduction Grip is molded on and offers the utmost in both comfort and durability, while reducing vibrations caused by impact. From the Manufacturer This nylon-vinyl shock reduction grip rip hammer is perfect for driving and removing nails. Fully polished forged one-piece solid steel construction eliminates loose heads while the nylon vinyl deep cushion grips bonded to steel handle for comfort and durability. Since 1923, the Estwing family and its employees have taken pride in designing and manufacturing the world's most durable, comfortable and attractive striking and struck tools. top_review: Listen, if Thor ever needed a backup hammer, this would be it. The ESTWING Hammer is an absolute beast, built like it was forged in the heart of a star. The moment you pick it up, you feel an immediate surge of power—or at least the confidence to smash some nails into oblivion.Durability – Practically IndestructibleThis thing doesn’t just hammer nails—it asserts dominance. Whether you're hanging a picture or demolishing a wall (on purpose, of course), it gets the job done with zero hesitation. Dropped it off a ladder? No problem. Left it in the rain? It doesn’t care. Used it to fend off a rogue spider? Perfect weight distribution.Grip – Feels Like an Extension of Your HandThe rubber grip is so comfortable, you’d think it was custom-molded for your palm. I’ve swung this thing for hours and never once felt like it would slip. In fact, if I ever need to pass this down to future generations, I’m confident it’ll outlast my entire bloodline.Precision & Power – Nails Never Stood a ChanceOne swing, and BOOM—that nail is in the wood like it owes you money. The balance is perfect, making every hit strong, controlled, and satisfying.✔ Feels great in hand—no awkward weight imbalance.✔ You’ll want to start fixing things just for an excuse to use it.✔ Can survive practically anything short of an asteroid impact.Final Thoughts – The Only Hammer You’ll Ever NeedIf you’re tired of cheap, flimsy hammers that bend when they see a tough nail, this ESTWING is the only hammer you’ll ever need. It’s heavy-duty, powerful, and makes you feel like a legend every time you use it.

title: Streamlight 69264 TLR-1 HL 1000-Lumen 20000 Candela Rail-Mounted Tactical Weapon Light with Earless Screw and Specific Compatibility Rail Locating Keys, Black
description: The Streamlight 69264 TLR-1 HL is a lightweight, compact, lithium battery powered gun-mounted tactical flashlight featuring the latest in shock-proof high power LED technology and providing 1.5 hours of continuous run time with 1000-lumens. Tethered battery door and latch mechanism prevents battery door loss while providing easy battery replacement. When enabled, the strobe is activated on two or more momentary paddle hits. Mounts directly to handguns with Glock-style rails and to all MIL-STD-1913 (Picatinny) Rails, however; kindly confirm fitment and compatibility prior to purchase. The Streamlight 69264 includes keys for Glock-Style, Picatinny, Beretta 90two, S&W 99 and S&W TSW handguns.

top_review: Bought this light to go onto a new pistol I had acquired with a rail. The multiple keys, lumens of output, and strobe feature were what drew me to the product. Streamlight has a good reputation as a quality manufacturer and I have some experience with some of their hand-held flashlights, so I figured this was pretty much a no-brainer.The details of this product are defined in its description and in many reviews before mine, so no point in beating a dead horse. Let me try to illuminate a couple of basic things that may or may not affect you: opening the battery compartment is pretty easy, now, with the new latch. You just pull/push it all the way until it goes about 180 degrees and the thing pops open all on its own. I suppose this is a new design compared to the many complaints about tight latches from before. First time I've had one of these, so I can't really say. The multiple keys are nice, in case you have multiple weapons with rails that you're trying to attach this thing to and hadn't planned ahead. Really, one should just try to have all of the same rail so these are more easily switched in any case.Unfortunately for me, I didn't look into this particular thing when I bought this. I bought a 1911 pistol that basically uses an STI frame, which uses some kind of slightly odd size rail. It seems to fit the glock key, but not well, as the glock key seems a bit tall. I had made the assumption, incorrectly, that the rail was a 1913 rail. This was entirely my fault, not Streamlight's, but I would like to see more than the four keys that seem to be available for this thing. A few small adjustments to this glock key should get me straightened out, as it currently will not sit on my pistol for longer than a few shots.I would have preferred a more solid mounting for the rail, in general, rather than the quick-on/off idea that seems to be behind this type of rail. I'd rather have to pry it off with a couple of tools and be sure its on there than be able to switch it around a lot... and that would be my only real source of discontent with this product.The strobe works pretty easily, though what actual tactical effect it might have is theoretical to me. I just bought this for the higher lumens of output compared to the standard TLR-1 and figured if it was useful, it would be nice to have, but wouldn't hurt me too much either way since I wouldn't be depending on it. Bought this for my night-stand pistol, and there are a few nice holsters that will fit the 1911 + TLR-1 combo well if you're inclined that way. I bought one just to have one and in case it is ever allowed as a duty weapon. I'd say I'm pretty happy with it, and as soon as I figure out this rail fit thing, I'm sure I'll get rid of that one little dissatisfaction as well. Overall, can't knock the product, just make sure your rail will fit one of the keys.*********************************************************Okay, so I've now owned this thing for awhile. Today is 11/13/13.The light is still going strong. My previous problem with the quick attach/detach option was that the light didn't fit that pistol correctly. I have since put it on a CZ SP-01 using the 1913 rail key. You are supposed to use a coin or most anything wide and flat to tighten the locking mechanism all the way. When the key actually fits, and you do this, the light stays on there all day. I haven't had it move since I figured this basic thing out and got less stubborn about it sitting on my odd-ball pistol rail.I highly recommend this as a weapon light. It works great. The few extra bucks for the extra lumens of light seem worth it. The strobe isn't easy to leave on in the constant mode, but works well in the temporary mode, which I gather is the most desirable use. It was neat to play with, but I don't see the point for your average person. Upgraded my review to 5 stars.

top_review: I am so glad I decided to spend some extra money and buy this brand of others because everything is just so well-made and excellently designed. I’m 5’7 and about 175 pounds and I was able to comfortable sit, kneel, and stand.The board is solid and durable. No leaks. The paddle has easy instructions to connect it. The fin hooks on easily. Unplugging and plugging the pump into this isn’t cumbersome like some models- the cap connects and twists easily.I don’t think enough people are raving at the carrying bag - it has chest and hip straps, side straps, and mesh padding to allow for comfortable carrying. Everyone in my family has paddle boards but NONE have bags comparable to this one.  The bag is also large enough where you don’t need a Master’s degree in architecture to figure out how to put everything bag in - simply fold the board with a normal level of common sense, and there is plenty room for everything. I am grateful for this because sometimes it is a nightmare putting everything back in.I was a bit concerned with the size of this being that it is much larger than other brands. I read online that that can slow down your ability to paddle and make turning cumbersome. I did not have any of those problems, and I’m not exactly the pinnacle model of fitness! The water I was on was quite choppy and windy, and was gliding across the water (and waves even after boats came by).Another note on the size: This is not that difficult to carry when inflated. The carrying strap in the center made it easy for me (again, not very strong) to carry it to the water. The weight is nicely balanced.This board has brought me so much joy, it has been one of the best purchases I have ever made and I’m glad I spent the extra money on this brand.

title: Valvoline Extended Protection Full Synthetic Motor Oil SAE 5W-30 5 Quart
description: Premium motor oil isn’t just for sports cars or luxury vehicles. Today’s engines produce more horsepower in a smaller package to improve fuel efficiency without sacrificing performance. Because engines are working harder, they demand next-level protection. Valvoline Extended Protection Full Synthetic Motor Oil provides superior protection from deposits, wear, heat and friction – the four major causes of engine breakdown. Our Dual Defense Additive Technology combines an innovative additive booster with a fortified detergent system to fight sludge and help keep engines clean for optimal performance and fuel efficiency. Valvoline Extended Protection Full Synthetic is 10x stronger against oil breakdown and offers 24x stronger protection against engine-killing contaminants than the industry-leading full synthetic.  And thanks to an exceptional range of temperature protection, your engine will be ready for extreme summer heat or frigid winter weather. Formulated to exceed the latest industry engine oil specifications (API SP, ILSAC GF-6 and GM dexos1), Valvoline Extended Protection Full Synthetic is our best oil, and your best choice, whether you drive a Toyota Camry, Ford F150, Chevy Silverado or anything in between.

The extended drain interval feature is a bonus, as it allows for fewer oil changes while maintaining top-notch protection. Overall, it's been a reliable and high-quality oil for my vehicle, and I highly recommend it.

title: SharkBite 1 Inch 90 Degree Elbow, Push to Connect Brass Plumbing Fitting, PEX Pipe, Copper, CPVC, PE-RT, HDPE, U260LFA
description: Product Description Easily connect pipe in seconds with the SharkBite Push to Connect 90 Degree Elbow. This 90 degree angle coupling elbow joins copper, PEX, CPVC, HDPE, or PE-RT pipe in any combination. With no soldering, clamps, or glue required, connections are as simple as inserting a pipe into the fitting deep enough to be sealed by the specially-designed O-ring. Once inserted, the fitting's stainless steel teeth bite down and grip the pipe. Disassembly is just as easy with the SharkBite disconnect tool. The SharkBite Elbow Joint is designed for potable water and radiant heating applications (including underground or behind-the-wall applications) with no access panels required. From the Manufacturer SharkBite is the push-fit connection system that's really taking hold. It's the easiest way to join copper, CPVC or PEX pipe in any combination - with no soldering, clamps, unions or glue. Just insert the pipe and the stainless steel teeth bite down and grip tight, while a specially formulated O-ring compresses to create a perfect seal. Disassembly is just as fast using the simple disconnect tool. So fittings and valves can be easily changed and reused. They can even be rotated after assembly for easier installation in tight spaces. Get SharkBite, and get a grip on your next plumbing project. These fittings are lead free and meet all requirements for plumbing in California and Vermont.

Available in 19 savory flavors, you'll be able to find a flavor that your kitty will crave no matter what stage of life they are (kitten to senior). top_review: Bought this as a gift for someone going on travel, and one for myself. Love that it’s small & portable. Love that you can play it alone. Super easy to learn and a game is completed very quickly. Highly recommend!!Everyone except young children. We were introduced to this game by family friends ranging in age from 12 to 15. We loved it so much we purchased it right away and played it the next day with our friends who are seniors. Everyone found the game easy to learn quick paced and fun. It deserves all the awards it has been given. Small enough to throw in a suitcase and take with for travel. And the banana theme is funWe ordered Bananagrams for a group travel abroad. It was very convenient to take with us, and very easy to pack. (About the size of a TV Remote)The game itself was fun and easy to learn. It can be very fast paced and can become hectic if you have a good wordsmith playing with you. Still very easy even if you’re not good with words!This game is so much more fun than I had anticipated! I play it solo all the time. But we take it on camping trips, or to family gatherings. It's really fun with 2-4 people. It's also more challenging that I had thought it would be. Overall, such an easy and fun came. It's portable, easy to store, and fun!What I love about banana grams is the cute bag, how compact it is to play (no board), and how it's a good game to stave off dementia. Also, great for communicating with the spirit realm, if you're into that! Fun for every dimension!We love this game! We've played it everywhere, game nights, family reunions, vacations. My teen even played it with friends at a game day. We left our first Bananagrams somewhere and had to replace it with this one- we couldn't be without Bananagrams! It's so fun, can be played by 2 or more people who can spell, and for a short or long time. Order this game! Fun and laughter will ensue. Happy spelling!This game is easy to learn, educational, portable and fun for the entire family!Inexpensive hours of family friendly fun and educational, too ! Great for building vocabulary and spelling skills on the sly. Also great for travel, lightweight and easy to pack. Our kids love it. It’s an excellent alternative to screens.The easiest way to describe this game is it's like Scrabble, but without a board and with no scoring. Inside the fabric banana case you'll find a ziploc plastic bag containing the sturdy plastic tiles (the letters are embossed into them) and a thin instructions booklet. My wife and I play this, and here's how it goes...You begin by putting the tiles face down onto a table, then each player picks 21 tiles (fewer if there are more players - the instructions tell you how many to take based on the number of participants). There are lots of silly banana-based cues in the game, and at the call "split" the players turn their tiles over. Then, it's a rush to build your own word grid on the table, like Scrabble without the board, trying to use up all of your letters. You can rearrange your grid as often as you like. If you are stuck, you can say "dump" and return a letter to the "bunch" of tiles on the table, but you must then take three more tiles. If you use up all your tiles, you say "peel" and take another one, but every other player must also take an extra tile too. Once you've used up all your tiles, and there no tiles left in the "bunch" on the table, shout out "bananas!" and you win. There's no scoring - it's simply a case of the first person to use all of their letters, and for there to be no more tiles in the bunch is the winner. Quick to learn, easy to play, and loads of fun.After a friend introduced me to Bananagrams, I was completely hooked. I went home and ordered a game for myself. I've played it with friends and relatives, made up my own modifications to the rules, and really love this game.Somehow Scrabble just seems too restrictive. This is a game for stretching your mind, encouraging creativity and I'm not actually at all bothered about winning or losing - just about the elegance of the challenge.Wonderful product, great quality, nice little 'nana bag'.The only downside is you do need quite a bit of space to lay out the tiles so you won't be playing it on a plane or train.The game is very good but the tiles I received are just a poor replica. When I played with friends the tiles were more solid and had a nicer feel like Scrabble tiles. My tiles are hollow and after several games the lettering is already wearing off. The letters are quite hard to make out and many are not centered on the tile. The banana shaped pouch is too small and badly made.Make sure you buy the AUTHENTIC game, which I can assure you is not this one.The game is excellent for any numbers of people and the rules can be varied to suit the ages of the players, ie; two letter words for youngsters. We enjoyed our friends one so much we bought our own, unfortunately not the same quality.I gave three stars because of the premise of the game, the quality of my game pack doesn't even deserve one star.Amazingly tactile tiles and I love the banana case itself. We pretty much make up our own rules with this but the idea is roughly you get a number of tiles each from a face down pile in the middle and then proceed to make as many words from your selection as you can all fitting together like a crossword layout. You can swap a tile you don't want by putting it back and getting two in it's place. You can also call 'spilt' and everyone has to take another tile from the middle. The winner has used all their tiles to make viable words before anyone else. I'd definitely buy another game from this series as they are such lovely quality and easy to reach for when you need a low-time set up family game.We bought this for a recent holiday, in the hope that it might be something the three generations could play together. The (alleged) adults like Scrabble, and we were trying to get the teenager to stretch his brain a bit. Unfortunately, the game didn't really work for us. It's not a joint/collaborative game, you play in parallel, each trying to make words from the letters that you have picked up. So if you don't already know a word, there isn't any kind of "prompt" from looking at someone else's words.You don't build on someone else's words like you do in Scrabble, so you don't talk to each other at all or have the opportunity to support your child to develop their vocabulary (despite the advertising pictures showing happy families laughing themselves into oblivion). You also don't get the additional practice that you get from keeping score in Scrabble. As a final insult, it's surprisingly heavy to pack, though the packaging is cute.

description: Product Description The ICON, the original Swiss tool that has inspired hundreds of other brands to knock off its design and attempt to replicate this heritage tool. So far till this day none reach its level of durability and performance. Amazon.com These classic Felco pruners set the standard by which all others are judged. The choice of landscape professionals, nursery workers, and savvy gardeners around the globe; this exceptionally well-made tool features a design that's been unchanged for more than 50 years. The anvil blade has a deep sap groove to prevent sticking. A Swiss, precision-made cutting blade with soft wire cutter is replaceable for maximum return on investment. An easily-adjusted bolt and nut allow users to customize blade alignment for more efficient operation. A rubber cushion with shock absorbers pads blades where they come together to reduce impact and strain on wrists. Strong, light, forged-aluminum alloy handles have a red, plastic coating that's molded for comfort (and makes pruners easier to spot in the garden). A non-corroding spring mechanism is covered with a metal sheath to protect from moisture. Ideal for trimming rose bushes and woody perennials, the Felco Original's smooth, soft action, ergonomic comfort, and exceptional durability put it in a class of its own. It's covered by a one-year warranty. However, with proper care, these pruners will last a lifetime. --Mary Park

This microwave-safe, dishwasher-friendly bowl comes with a pair of matching chopsticks. The playful, white dish is designed to look just like the Pokeball from the classic animer series. Silver Buffalo provides fans with their favorite official character merch. Working in collaboration with licensors and brands, Silver Buffalo develops unique, creative, and ground-breaking products with a devotion to detail and innovation. Silver Buffalo prides itself on manufacturing and distributing playful products that connect fans with their favorite cartoon characters, superheroes, movies, tv-series and more. Celebrate your fandom!
top_review: First off, they really nice looking (I ordered three different designs. One for myself, another for my mom, and one for a friend). The bowls are rather thick. The matching ceramic spoon is sturdy and thick. The chopsticks are standard ones (not the best but they will be serviceable for a year or two). It is about the right size for a package of bigger ramen (like Korean ramen). It can easily fit the smaller ramen sizes that you buy at the regular grocery store. Obviously it can be used for anything that a normal bowl can be used for. If it is on sale, I highly recommend buying.

top_review: I like that it's divided into 5 sections. If I work on a project, I use each section for each aspect of my work. The pockets in the section dividers are perfect for storing extra notes in. Once I started buying this notebook, I didn't want any other.I hate how expensive these notebooks are, but I got a little relief by going through Amazon (I think 🤔). At least it’s what my son needed for school, and it is living up to its purpose. Two thumbs up, would recommend.I'm impressed. I was just looking for a this notebook because it's Saturday, so it would survive a semester of classes. Turns out the study app works great! I saw the same general idea with the Rocket notebooks, but you erase the information once it's uploaded. I figure that this way you still keep the notes even if the app goes obsolete in time.I use it for multiple subjects and this notebook is perfect. Bleeding of pens is also not really a problem for these pages either.I should have read the description better before buying. This is what we were looking for; college ruled, 5 subject, pocket folders, black cover spiral notebook. But it comes with the new study app system which means there are arrows on the left of each line and a scan box on the corners (see pic). Mu daughter who is in HS now is concerned that some teachers might not like that. I'm not sure that will be an issue but it might be in some schools or with some teachers who are strict on unform paper styles.I am almost 100% sure we will not be using that app. Maybe others will find it useful.bought bc i didn’t feel like going to the store this is a good notebook!Each corner has a tiny code bar symbol. Easily can upload page to phone or file. College daughter could probably explain much better. Me... Not So Much!Being older, I'm a bit challenged when it comes to this kinda stuff. LOL. (Purchased for my 3rd yr. College daughter). She likes it!Does the job!I was close to 5 stars until I started using it. It is described as college ruled, which are narrower lines. It is frustrating when you expect to take more notes per page.Plusses: Hard paper so doesn't make a lot of 'lint' on my pen. Pages are heavy enough that fountain pen doesn't bleed and can use both sides… (But markers would bleed)Structure is stiff enough to write on my lap when flipped around, but I wish the back board were just a bit more rigid… It does bend a fair bit. But good enough.I love the pages are perforated so I can tear out a page without all the little ring holes in it. That allows it to go into a 3 ring binder perfectly.Cover is smooth enough to wipe off if needed.Está perfecto para la escuela, con 5 divisiones claramente marcadas por el separador de manila con su pestaña para guardar documentos u hojas sueltas. Alcanza perfecto para el uso generoso de 5 materias al semestre. Es grande pero no estorboso y no pesa tanto como 5 cuadernos juntos... Es un muy buen producto.Este es un producto que suelo comprar con regularidad, me parece de buena calidad, las hojas son muy cómodas para escribir sin embargo el cuidado que tienen para empacar el envío deja que desear. La esquina de mi cuaderno venía con las hojas dobladas. No lo voy a regresar, pero creo que deberian poner más atención a sus envíos para que llegue el producto en buen estado.Creo que tal vez mis expectativas eran mayores, ya que cuando estudié usaba de este tipo de cuadernos y la calidad era extraordinaria, en esta ocasión mi crítica es para el papel de las hojas, porque es muy delgado y la impresión de las rayas y márgenes, la línea roja del margen así como las líneas (rayas) para Guía de escritura son tenues o en algunas hojas incluso sin impresión en algunas secciones.Nothing wrong with it! Pages are there, none wrecked, no scratches or markings! Just like what you buy at Walmart! Recommend it if you’re looking for a notebook!

top_review: I am a Duracell die hard fan! I have tried other batteries, cheaper batteries, more expensive batteries, and none of them in my opinion work as well as Duracell in most cases. I use a lot of batteries so I buy them in bulk which creates a less price per piece in bulk. What’s the say except that I like them! I am continuing to purchase Duracell batteries #1FANI use this product for a device that needs power from a battery. As for how long each battery will last, only time will tell. So, as of right now, my device that needed power is working fine. And lastly, a good value for the money.I ran out of the batteries and the ones I was using were acting weird at the time. I thought it was either batteries or the remote.. the evening after i got the batteries I had to replace the old ones.. I'm SO glad they got here quickly and they have a hundred years on them... just kidding. it's 10 years I think. I immediately put the new ones in the remote and the spares in my little wooden box for batteries. haI have alot of gadgets that use AAA batteries so I like to have them on hand.No complaints about the seller or the quality of the batteries nor their longevity.However, I ordered 56 units and received only 48 in sealed envelopes.I liked the sealed package more so than the open containers.I assumed that their were 56 batteries.After recounting and again recounting I noticed that I had received too few batteries.After contacting the seller I received an immediate credit for the missing batteries. Excellent service from the seller though.I gave only 4 stars since I had not been informed of the reduced quantity beforehand.I HAVE ALWAYS USED DURACELL BATTERIES. I PURCHASED A CONTAINER FOR MY BATTERIES SO I ALWAYS KNOW WHEN TO REPLENISH THEM.Good Looking, used where needed (flashlights, telephone, etc.)Batteries.... nothing more or less than you would find in every store just a larger pack at a better priceI purchased these batteries and after 10 of them for past couple months, realized they are not lasting long at all.I've used 8 of them already and was wondering why they only lasted a couple months in my remotes (TV & Audio components) so before installing the next pair, I decided to check the voltage. Despite the outer casing being labelled "Mar 2028", the voltage on all of them are approximately 0.800 volts.At this point, I can't ask for a return because I only have 8 remaining. I never expected Duracell batteries to have low voltage after sitting for just 2 months. I keep them stored in a drawer with other batteries that I also tested and they are all holding correct voltage. Only these Duracell AAA are low.I do not recommend these batteries. I have no explanation why these batteries would be defective as I've never experienced this in the past with Duracell. I can only speculate this batch that Amazon got was bad.As a rule, I have used name brand batteries in the past but I did try to use a no name brand to see how it would hold up in terms of longevity. Well they may be less expensive but their longevity is not good. So I went back to Duracell which has proven to me that even though you pay more, you are getting a product that will perform extremely well. I primarily use the AAA for my television remotes, computer mouse and my little flashlight (which I use a lot as my cats like to chase the little “red dot” option) Anyway these batteries last far longer than other name brands I have tried. Value for money is great!I mean, it's a giant pack of batteries - highly recommend if you want batteries that'll keep your electronics going quite a long time. I only recommend for large households or people who use a LOT of batteries though - I still had half the box after about 9 months and although I stored them in a dry, dark area, the batteries have crystallized on the outside and aren't functional anymore. So I only got to use half of them, and the other half went to the depot. Disappointing.$19.99 for 16 batteries seems to be on the expensive side- Duracell batteries tend to last longer than other brands when used in most electronics, especially video game controllers- package has a cut out at the back for pulling the batteries out/keeping them organized in the package, but package could be more box like in order to help with storing themThere's a lot of non-name batteries on the market, most made by one of the "big name" manufacturers, and often sold at a considerably lower price than the big name brands. But, when I want a battery I know I can store in a cupboard for a few months or even years before I need it, and I want a battery that won't leak and ruin sensitive equipment, I am still willing to pay a premium for Duracell batteries. Put simply, I have never had a bad experience with a Duracell, over many decades of use: not one has leaked, or gone flat while in storage waiting for use. Sure, you can save a few dollars on a no-name (and I do for some applications) but where I need a battery I know will last and not cause problems, I buy these Duracell packs.

top_review: You're in high school. Your pencil case is full of the mismatched assortment of pens without caps and mechanical pencils with half a stick of lead each that you've found on those familiar tiled floors. In fact, you can't even remember the last time you actually bought a pack or pens or pencils (besides of course, a week before the first day of school to avoid detention for not having the obligatory 3 red pens, a hilighter, and whatever else was on the syllabus). On your way to third period, daydreaming about that warm sunny schoolyard on the other side of those wide windows, walking on autopilot, you kick something and hear that familiar rolling sound. You look down, snapped out of your daydream state, praying that you happened to kick the pen just right, and not into the opposite lane of hurried kids. Your eye lands on the silver pen, and you quickly squat down to pick up your prize. Upon picking it up, you stuff it into your pocket, and make your way to third period. When you reach the classroom, you take out the newest addition to your collection of adopted writing utensils, and quickly pen your name across the top right of the handout placed on your desk. You feel a twinge of disappointment as the pen leaves nothing but a slight indent on the paper. Your hand moves to the bottom left of the handout, and you scribble a couple circles to see if the pen has any life left whatsoever. Success! A trail of black ink follows the point of your pen, and you pen your name again in the top right, only this time the results of your penmanship stare back at you in jet black. You complete the handout in around 20 minutes, then turn your head to the homework board, and begin to write down the assigned chapters of The Scarlett Letter that you'll read on the bus this afternoon. As you use the instrument again, you notice how it feels in your hand. It's not heavy, but it's not light as a feather either; it's a kind of heft that makes the pen feel like a quality piece of metal. You observe that this pen's clip looks and feels surprisingly strong, and as you pack up your things in preparation for that long awaited bell, you introduce the pen to it's new family of writing utensils in your pencil case. For the rest of the day, you notice that every time you grab a pen, you feel around for the silver pen each time without even thinking. You like that pen; it's strong yet springy clip, it's smooth rolling action, it's easy hold grip, even the way it clicks open and closed is just different from any other pen you can recall using. It feels like a real writing tool, not some cheap black plastic value pack pen. Days go by, and weeks go by. You've forgotten what your old pens felt like, you've grown fully accustomed to the smooth action of your acquisition. One day while writing a couple paragraphs on the ending of The Scarlett Letter, your pen starts to grow a bit faint. Your hand moves once again to the bottom left of your packet, and you scribble a couple circles into the page. Nothing. Another dead pen doesn't mean much, and you were finished with your response anyway, so you tuck the pen back into your pocket and head to your next class. You walk right past the garbage can without thinking, and after realizing this, you simply take the pen out of your pocket and drop it on the ground from whence it came. You arrive at fifth period and unzip your backpack to take a pen from your trusty stash. You pick a simple black plastic pen, placing it on the left side of your desk. After the teacher demonstrates the topic of the day, you are presented with a worksheet to complete by the end of class. You reach for your pen, remove the cap, and place the cap to the left of your worksheet. You write your name, and realize something is wrong. Instead of gliding smoothly on the surface of the paper, your pen poorly etches black lines. You feel that slight resistance, that friction of pen on paper that you haven't felt in weeks. You're back to the same pen everyone else uses, the uniform standard, the unimaginative piece of black plastic that you've used for the last decade of your life. For the rest of the day you feel a bit off, but you don't understand why, and eventually brush it off after you walk off the bus onto your driveway. The next day, and the day after, you use the same pen, until eventually it too runs dry of ink. You take another black plastic pen from the pile to replace it, and feel no difference from the switch this time. You once again grow used to the friction, the slightly too tight plastic cap, and the lack of any sort of grip that all come standard with every plain black plastic pen. Days go by, weeks go by, years go by. You use pens daily in your work, but you've never thought about stepping outside of that plain, unimaginative uniform standard. One day at work, you roll your chair a bit too far to the side, and roll over your mobile charger. You go on Amazon to buy a new one, and knowing not to buy cheap bulk chargers that charge slow and break quickly, you settle on a $15 charger with $3 shipping. You see that shipping is free if you spend more than $25, and so you think; what is an item that we use daily, but never really think to upgrade? You search for pens on Amazon, below $15, and come across a familiar writing utensil. It's the silver pen! It's been so long that you didn't even remember the brand name, but you could recognize that pen anywhere. You place it in your cart, and both ship to your house within the week. You open the package, slip the pen out of the cardboard back of it's protective plastic bubble, and clip it to your pocket. The next day, you put your lunch in the fridge at work, and grab a post it note to tag it with your name. As you take your pen off your pocket, you click it and feel that perfect amount of resistance. You feel the sturdy grip, the hefty weight in your hand, and begin to pen your name. The pen smoothly glides across the yellow paper square, and you clip the pen to your pocket once more.Yes, it's a $10 pen. Zebra pens are worth it. Absolutely worth it.You can spend a lot more on a pen. You can find smaller form factors for specialized EDC use (e.g. pocket carry). But for $15 putting a Fisher SPR4F fine black refill in a Zebra F-701 is hard to beat.The Zebra is now all-stainless steel. It is well balanced in the hand, and the knurling provides outstanding grip and stability when writing. This allows the writer to use comfortable grip pressure, as compared to slicker-barreled pens that require a firmer grasp. The clicker is outstanding and the clip is rugged.The Fisher fine refill is only slightly more fine than the regular Fisher refill. If north northwest is mostly north and only slightly west, then the SPR4F is medium medium fine. And so it is as smooth to write with as the regular refill. The main benefit comes from no "clumping" (which often smudges) when picking up the pen after a long absence. It just writes perfectly from the get go.I have several of these pens lying around my home and office. Several more in my briefcase and travel gear. There is always one around, and they WORK EVERY TIME. End of discussion.I’ve mainly used the m-301 in the past and compared the that this pencil is fantastic. The main problem I’ve experienced with the m-301 is lead breaking easily and that the pencil would stop working at some point in time. With m-701 I’ve had yet to experience that, I even bought extra lead cases because I had expected the lead to break just as easily, but it’s the complete opposite. Over the course of owning the pencil and using it righteously during my time at school I don’t think the lead had even broken on me maybe twice over a 1-4 month school time period but that’s it and most likely that was me genuinely apply a substantial amount of pressure to the lead. However my only and forever gripe about zebras pencils is that the erasers just fade away to easily I spend more time buying erasers than I do with lead. Other than that the m-701 is my daily driver.I may have been drinking, and posting some smart alec reviews on Amazon, but this is for real. This is a very nice pen, and is literally here next to me at the computer. It has a nice heft, but not too heavy. It lays down ink nicely, it is a ball-point, which I prefer to the scritchy fountain pens.At this price point you won't cry if it gets lost or stolen, and you could probably buy a few back-ups. But it is a nicer pen than some old scrubby mass produced thing, and will look nice when crossing swords with your intellectual adversaries, much like the business card scene in American Psycho. You will win with this pen! It is definitely mightier than the sword.I do a lot of writing in a clean environment. That makes this the perfect pen for me. This is my second one only because I lost the first one after more than 18 months of daily use. With refills of course! Easy to say I love this pen.This became my favorite pen immediately. Feels durable and like a high quality device in my hand. Writes smoothly. It doesn't look like anyone else's pen in the room. Be careful. Those who borrow it will not give it back willingly.I yell at my wife like it’s her fault it’s kissing when I lose this penWhenever I let people use it, I have to make sure I get it back because everyone likes using it.My low rating is NOT for the pen itself, but for the incorrect listing.There are two versions of the f-701. One is ALL steel including the top click assembly, and one is black plastic. The first picture on this listing shows the ALL steel version, and scrolling down it shows the "ALL STEEL" advertisement.Upon receipt this is not the ALL steel version, but the version with the black plastic click assembly. Disappointing that it is not as advertised.I'll keep it and mod it, but still disappointed. Don't buy this pen if you're looking specifically for the all steel version.I only bought the pen on a whim after reading about one in a fiction book and have been pleasantly surprised by it. A well made good looking very sturdy pen. It not too light or bulky, it just feels and looks right in all aspects. The knurled grip ensures a nice firm grip when writing and the ink flow from its 0.7mm nib is clean and smooth. No leakage or blobs of ink. Even though it is an import, the cost is much more reasonable than a few similar pens currently available in the UK. Time will tell how long it lasts before a refill is needed but right now the pen is a top buyThis will sound odd - but I was looking around for a "self defence" or "tactical" type pen for a martial arts class. I wanted to find something that didn't look like a piece of combat gear (most tactical pens) but that would not collapse under significant abuse and impact force. This pen is almost perfect. It has a very thick steel tubular construction. The students in the class made multiple attacks on pumpkins as a test case and not only did the pen not break but it continues to work as a pen !As a writing instrument, the quality of the ink is great (though I understand it will fit "space pen" refills" which are very popular with pen aficionados. It has a nice weight and a solid clicking mechanism. The grasping point is knurled to prevent slippage.All metal pencil. Bought two of them to go in two EDC bags, to go with Zebra F701 Ballpoint Pens. Go great together, all metal, strong writes/draws well, feels good in the hand, not too heavy.It is the perfect writing tool - well made, precise and comfortable to write with Love it!

description: The Amerock BP53005G10 Edona 1-1/4 inch (32mm) Diameter Knob is finished in Satin Nickel. As timeless as it is versatile, the Edona knob injects style as a standalone or paired with a variety of pull styles. Enduring and versatile, satin nickel marries delicate brushing with a subtle warm hue to produce an approachable, classic presentation that resonates across all design styles. Founded in 1928, Amerock’s award-winning home solutions including decorative and functional cabinet hardware, bath accessories, decorative hooks and wall plates have built the company’s reputation for chic design accessories that inspire homeowners to express their personal style. Amerock offers a variety of styles and finishes at affordable prices that add the perfect finishing touch to any room.
top_review: Great quality at a very reasonable price point. I ordered the satin nickel to best match my stainless appliances and they were perfect. They even matched the other satin nickel pulls I purchased from another manufacturer so I appreciated the consistent finish.These knobs are very solid and heavy! I actually dropped one on my cheap tile floor and the tile chipped while the knob remained unscathed.The finish is also quite smooth and easy on the hands. My kitchen came with sharp square knobs and these are a huge upgrade. I also had an odd number of knobs to replace and it’s awesome that these came in multi packs or as singles, and they don’t charge an outrageous price for a single!Over all these were perfect for my needs since I am a renter I did not want to spend a fortune or buy extra that I wouldn’t use.

title: GU Energy Original Sports Nutrition Energy Gel, 24-Count, Tri-Berry
description: GU Original Sports Nutrition Energy Gel is the energy gel that started it all. In 1993, Dr. Bill Vaughn developed the world’s first energy gel to help his daughter perform better during ultra-marathons, and GU has been helping to propel the world’s most successful extreme athletes to success ever since. GU Energy Gel sustains all forms of athletic activity with a highly compact, portable, and calorie-dense packet that is loaded with carbohydrates that can be rapidly absorbed. Branched-chain amino acids limit muscle fiber damage and increase speed of recovery, and extra electrolytes help maintain water balance. Some flavors feature caffeine to increase concentration. While the original formula has been tweaked and evolved over the years, the end result is still the same: GU Energy Gels fuel the best endurance athletes in the world. GU Original Energy Gel comes in a wide variety of good tasting flavors. Each packet contains 450mg of Amino acids, 100 calories, and at least 21g total carbs.
top_review: All the flavors are pretty good. I got these for marathon training, I only use them during long runs around the 4 mile mark and they definitely help. So far so good, would purchase again.These are my go-to for long runs. The taste is great and they do what they're supposed to with an energy boost. I also wish the top stayed attached like some other brands since it's easy for them to slip out.They are easy to consume, taste great and keep me running.I just don't like to have to carry the package after consuming it.1st time using something like this on a bike ride.It gives you energy that you need fast and also taste good. Its convenient and not too big. Definitely recommend for long rides.I like GU. It helps me make it through my intense training days without making me dizzy or giving me heart palpatations the way pre-workout would. I usually take it after my warm-up and cardio are done, for the boost of energy I need to get through my strength routine. These little gels also make it easier to get through morning workouts before breakfast without absolutely crashing halfway through. I love these gels as a workout aid! I have even noticed less muscle soreness since I started using them.However, the flavors available are disappointing. I have bought GU from this seller, but also at a pre-marathon booth and let me tell you... there are 4 times as many flavors as this Amazon seller provides. Where is the Blackberry? The basic flavors are the least pallatable because there is less flavoring to hide the taste of the gel. Please list more flavors!I've used GU while cycling for 25+ years. Chocolate is the best. It's amazing what proper nutrition can do for you on a longer endurance workout. Gu recommends that you take one serving every 45 minutes; I find this is not quite enough for me; I'll take one every 30-45 minutes depending on exertion levels while doing multi-hour mountain bike rides (I'm also 205 lbs, so I think I have higher energy intake requirements). The main gripe I have with this assorted flavor pack, is that only one flavor is caffeine free. I really like the caffeine most of the time, but sometimes I work out in the evenings and don't want caffeine before bed. I'll be buying Gu's again, but not the variety pack.I know there are cheaper ones out there by different brands but I decided to try this. Thick and and a great taste. I haven't tried all the flavours yet but early indications point to good things. If this is the same people who make deserts for sale in all major supermarkets then no wonder!I use GU as I feel like I have eaten something when I use them BUT they are very sticky so make sure your carrying a rubbish bag and a wet wipe when out on those long runsThese are great. Overall very pleasedSwitched to GU gels from High5 six months ago and prefer the GU consistency/flavours and I carry fewer of them. Great product.These taste pretty good, but they are very pricey and come in packaging that's unrecyclable in the UK. Won't be buying them until GU sort out their eco-obligations

top_review: I heard a gaming blog say that this is one of the largest board games out there. I wouldn't be surprised if that were true.  We have to play this at the dining room table, as a standard coffee table would be far too small.  The object of the game is to explore a haunted house and build the house.  As you move through doorways on your turn, you randomly pick a room tile to represent the room that you are entering. Each room will have an Event (something good or bad that causes you to roll, draw an item, move to a different room of the house, etc.), Omen (usually an object that can help), or Item.  There are rooms that can boost your character's skills.The goal of the game is to explore the house, collecting items and improving your character before the "Haunt" starts.  Once it does one or more of the players will turn "Traitor", leave the room, and read their individual objective in a different book.  The remaining players will read their instructions.  When the traitor comes back (with their individual secret rules), the game continues as a vs. game.The game can get tense and there are several of the objectives that have some unclear instructions.  Be ready to "house rule" a few unclear items.  It is not a deal-breaker - in a game this complex there is likely to be some errors that were uncaught by editors and play testers.  To add to the game, get the Widow's Walk Expansion, but I have noticed that the haunts in the expansion are a little too intense for my 9 year old.  For a more youth-friendly game try "Betrayal at Mystery Mansion", a Scooby Doo themed game that is similar, but less complex.I will say that it is intended to be a cooperative game; however, players tend to get suspicious after a few games and don't really help out each other because of the risk that the person that they are building up will at some point turn traitor.  The secrecy of the rules can cause some angst if you are not comfortable with the group you are playing with.Despite its flaws, this is one of our go-to games for game night.  We have not gotten through all of the possible haunts and even if you are at risk of repeating one, there are alternate rules that allow you to randomly select a haunt you haven't played.Most of our games range between an hour (speed game) to an hour and a half, though you could get up to two hours, depending on how quickly the haunt starts and how complex the situation is.  I would certainly recommend.

top_review: These are the best gloves I’ve had so far! Meanwhile these things stood up to dremelling, painting, even my dang parrot!As with the rest of the people here, the sizes are small. I knew already that I wear a size Small glove, so I ordered it anyway, but the box shows that I would need an extra small. The Small fits my hand like any of my other gloves, so if you know what size you usually wear, get that and don’t listen to what the box says. My work requires my gloves to be tight (otherwise the glove will get in my way or leave marks in the clay which is undesirable) so I might try the XS just to see if that would be better for my particular use of it, but the size I ordered fit comfortably and snug! I wouldn’t hesitate to order these again, and will come back when I need to restock for sure.These gloves are great. It's my hands that aren't a perfect Small, Medium or Large. For those that say these don't fit well, it's because their hands, like mine, aren't the ideal size. The issue is these gloves are fairly thick they don't stretch like other thinner nitrile gloves. My hands are between 2 sizes so I buy the smaller size. I'd rather have tighter fitting gloves when slicing items in the kitchen than using looser gloves which could be more dangerous. I've had a few pairs simply burst and break on me when I stretch out my hands but it's not as bad as it sounds. I tend to reuse gloves until they puncture so they only fail and break on me when I've used them every day for 5+ days or so. This is about 1-2 hours of kitchen use every day. Very rarely have they simply failed when putting them on. It simply feels tight with a new pair. I say to myself it's just exercise for my hands. After the first 30 minutes of use the gloves stretch marginally to accommodate my slightly larger hands and you don't even notice the strain. I bought Ammex gloves of the same size and I simply notice it's thinner and stretches more easily. It's unfortunately not my cup of tea (look for my review there).If you respect the difference that this is thicker and meant for a specific hand size then you wouldn't have any problems. Too bad they just don't make more sizes with smaller increments.I bought these primarily for home automotive work and I am very pleased with the gloves. I used the palm sizing chart which put me at a Med and they fit perfectly snug on my hands. The surface texture is also nice for added grip. This could just be time of year, but I don't think my hands sweat as much in these as they do in the standard exam gloves.I would typically go through 2-3 pairs of the standard thinner gloves each time I worked on a car. Either a glove would rip from stress or the carb cleaner/degreaser I was using would quickly degrade and eat through. With these gloves I was able to scrape, clean and do whatever needed and only use a single pair. I was able to break though a glove by scraping against my transmission with a fingernail for a bit, but this was on purpose.On another use I wrenched for about 2 hours with them, wiped them off a little and switched to my Mx Impact gloves to protect my nuckles. Then I was actually able to go back reuse the same pair I took off. They are not advertised as multiple use, but it is possible in some situations.Hope my review helps someone wondering if the additional cost is worth it over the basic exam gloves. I definitely think it is and will be buying more when needed.My wife and I own a small house cleaning business, so the gloves are worn while dusting, scrubbing, vacuuming, and mopping. Much research later we tried the 6 mil nitrile gloves from GLOVEWORKS (https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B01G346JJ2/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_asin_title_o03_s00?ie=UTF8&psc=1) but they proved to be not very durable, generally tearing where the thumb meets the palm after not much use. They do run a bit smaller than the GLOVEWORKS gloves, but the material stretches slightly after they've been on for a short while so all is well. Highly recommened (until they cheapen the manufacturing process, ha ha).
